insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options shown: 3L/4L/5L/7.5L/10L/15L/20L/25L (Classic & Enhanced plans) + No Claim Bonus as per Section 3.10/4.5

great.name: NCB
great.quote: If a claim has been made in the immediately preceding Policy Year, We will not increase or decrease the Sum Insured due to this benefit for the Policy Year.
great.explanation: If you made a claim in the previous policy year, the Sum Insured is not increased or decreased due to No Claim Bonus for the next year. This avoids a drop in cover because of a claim, but also means you don’t get an NCB increase after a claim year.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 36 months from the policy start date. Claims for PEDs will be payable only after you complete 3 years of continuous coverage.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Listed specific diseases/procedures are not covered for the first 24 months from the policy start date. You will have to wait 2 years before claims for those listed conditions become payable.

good.name: Room Rent
good.quote: Room Rent (per day) ... Single Private Room
good.explanation: Room rent is covered up to a Single Private Room as per the benefit table. Choosing a higher room category can reduce the claim payout due to linked room-rent conditions.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: The Re-fill amount may be used for only subsequent claims ... and shall not be for any Illness / Injury (including its complications or follow up) for which a claim has been paid or accepted as payable in the current Policy Year for the same Insured Person.
good.explanation: The refill sum insured can be used only for subsequent claims and not for the same illness/injury (including complications/follow-up) in the same policy year. This helps when you have a second, unrelated hospitalization after exhausting the base sum insured.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay above mentioned Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 30 days immediately preceding the Insured Person’s admission
good.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered up to 30 days before admission. Diagnostic tests and consultations older than 30 days before hospitalization won’t be payable.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses only for period up to 60 days immediately following the Insured Person’s discharge
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered up to 60 days after discharge. Follow-up medicines and tests beyond 60 days will not be covered.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will indemnify on Reimbursement basis only, the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Domiciliary hospitalization is covered on a reimbursement basis for eligible home treatment. You may need to pay first and then submit documents to get reimbursed.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from the policy start date, except accidents. Claims for non-accident medical conditions in the first month will be rejected.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure II - List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ...
bad.reference: Annexure II – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves, masks and nebulisation kits are listed as not covered. This can add meaningful out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization even when the main bill is covered.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a Hospital room where the room category opted or Room Rent incurred is higher than the eligibility as specified in the Policy Schedule, then We shall be liable to pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If you take a room higher than your eligible category, the insurer pays only a pro-rated portion of associated medical expenses. This can sharply reduce claim payout even if the treatment itself is otherwise covered.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: A 20% Co-payment will apply under Classic plan available under the product for treatment in Delhi NCR, Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai and Thane), Kolkata & Gujarat State.
bad.reference: Section 5 Claim Cost Sharing; also echoed in Annexure III (Co-Payment)
bad.explanation: A 20% co-payment applies under the Classic plan for treatment in Delhi NCR, Mumbai (including Navi Mumbai and Thane), Kolkata and Gujarat State. You must pay 20% of the admissible claim amount in these locations, reducing effective coverage.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: A limit of maximum INR 1 Lac will apply to all robotic surgeries, except the following: i. Robotic total radical prostatectomy ii. Robotic cardiac surgeries iii. Robotic partial nephrectomy iv. Robotic surgeries for malignancies
bad.reference: Section 3.15 Modern Treatments – Special condition applicable for robotic surgeries
bad.explanation: Most robotic surgeries are capped at a maximum of ₹1 lakh, with only certain listed robotic procedures exempted. If your robotic surgery is not in the exemption list, you may face a large shortfall.

bad.name: Mental Health Coverage
bad.quote: The following disorders / conditions shall be covered only up to 10% of Base Sum Insured or Rs. 50,000, whichever is lower.
bad.explanation: Mental disorder treatment is covered only up to 10% of Base Sum Insured or ₹50,000, whichever is lower. This sub-limit can be inadequate for longer admissions or intensive psychiatric care.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
